game.name: Frontlines : Fuel of War (Germany)(En,De)
game.desc: Frontlines: Fuel of War is a first-person action game for Xbox 360. The title plunges you into the middle of the oil war between the Western bloc (USA and Europe) and the Eastern bloc (Russia and China). In single or multiplayer mode, choose your class (assault, heavy assault, sniper, anti-vehicle, special forces or hand-to-hand) and go into battle.
